---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or new feature for this project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves
Describe the problem this feature would solve. Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case
Describe how you would use this feature and in what scenarios.

## Benefits
- Who would benefit from this feature?
- How does it improve the project?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Implementation Ideas (Optional)
If you have thoughts on how this could be implemented, share them here.
